name: Recover the Relics
primaryObjective: Score 1 VP for each controlled objective during every scoring Round.
setup: Place one Relic marker at each of the five objective markers. Each Relic is a separate Scenario Object. The objective marker remains in place if its Relic is removed.

recoverRelic.rule: An eligible unengaged Unit within 1" of an unclaimed Relic may perform a Recover Mission Action in Movement or Assault, replacing its normal action in that phase. The Unit becomes the Relic's carrier.
carrierRules: May voluntarily drop the Relic during its activation.
recoverRelic.recoveryFromGround: A Relic may be recovered from the ground by either side using the same Mission Action.

deliverRelic.rule: A carrier that ends its Movement or Assault Move wholly within its friendly Deployment Zone may deliver its Relic. Remove the Relic from play. Each Relic can be delivered only once.
deliverRelic.relicDeliveryPoints: Each successfully delivered Relic awards 2 bonus Primary VP once. A player may score at most 4 delivery VP per Round. These finite delivery VP are tracked separately from the ordinary objective-control Primary VP cap, and are awarded when delivery is resolved (normally during Movement or Assault). They count toward the 10-VP Decisive Victory check at the end of that Round's Scoring Phase; do not check the lead mid-Phase. A delivery made in Round 1 is recorded but does not award VP until the Round 2 Scoring Phase; for Tactical scoring only, it counts as delivered during Round 2. This preserves the universal no-scoring Round 1 rule without penalizing early delivery.

tacticalObjective.name: Secure an Artifact
tacticalObjective.effect: Gain 1 Tactical VP if you deliver at least one Relic during the current Round.

designNotes: Recover the Relics creates a tradeoff between holding objectives and carrying valuable objects away from the front. The Relics do not replace the normal capture objectives, so players must balance territorial scoring against extraction.
